values.note: Online reservations ran 5/18-9/13 in 2026; from 9/14 through the park's close all sites are first-come. Up to 14 nights per reservation. Call center 800-332-1501. Sites 5, 6 and 14 and one near 17 aren't reservable.

Map classes: S up to 20 ft, M up to 25, L up to 30, X up to 35. S sites won't fit a 23-ft rig. Sites 6, 12 and 16 are walk-in tent; site 24 is administrative. Adirondack shelters at 5, 6, 12, 14 and 16.

summary: Fees and season stand. Added 35 sites to 35 ft, no electric, showers, drinking water, some sites FCFS, 14-night cap. --AWH note kept.
